chunks: The day We shall summon all men with their leaders, whosoever is given his record in his right hand will be able to read his account, and none will be wronged the breadth of a thread.

key_terms.فَتِيلًا: the breadth of a thread (a small amount)
key_terms.كِتَابَهُ: his record or book of deeds

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when a person is given their book in the right hand on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'Imam' here is often interpreted as the specific leader or school of thought each individual followed in life, culminating in the ultimate authority of the Ahl al-Bayt. The 'Book of Deeds' being read with ease signifies a transparent accounting where the righteous recognize their good deeds as a source of joy rather than fear. This verse underscores the principle of divine justice, ensuring that no soul is burdened beyond its capacity or treated unfairly in the final reckoning.
